relation: one contract, by conversion: Extremal.XE1.xe1_tree and Packing.XE1.xe1_tree (is_forest [set: T] /\ connected [set: T]) are definitionally the upstream GraphTheory.core.sgraph.is_tree [set: T], the whole-carrier tree (unique irredundant paths and connectivity over every vertex); no second predicate and no nonempty guard are introduced, so 'K_0 stays a tree. GTBase.trees is a focused support layer over the upstream canonical: the Boolean is_treeb with is_treeP, the whole-carrier projections/introduction, and groundings ('K_0, 'K_1, 'K_2 and the claw 'K_1,3 are trees; 'K_3 and two isolated vertices are not). A tree on an arbitrary supplied vertex set is upstream's broader API; both migrated wrappers select the whole carrier. Distinct, untouched: B18's labelled fg_spanning_tree (a valid edge subset of a host), B19's multigraph edge-carrier spanning_tree_edge_set, D2tur.tree_on / shortest_tree_on, U9.tree_contains_T, the directed trees of X2 and P9, and B9's degree-bounded path_tree.
summary: Family B20 (whole simple-graph trees). The wrappers `Extremal.conjectures.XE1.xe1_tree` and `Packing.conjectures.XE1.xe1_tree` (`is_forest [set: T] /\ connected [set: T]`) now unfold to the upstream canonical `GraphTheory.core.sgraph.is_tree [set: T]`, the same conjunction, by conversion: the whole-carrier tree, unique irredundant paths and connectivity over every vertex. No second tree predicate and no nonempty guard are introduced (`'K_0` stays a tree); a tree on an arbitrary supplied vertex set is upstream's broader API, both wrappers select the whole carrier. The new public support module `GTBase.trees` (not re-exported by `GTBase.base`) adds the Boolean form `is_treeb` with `is_treeP`, the whole-carrier projections `is_treeT_forest` / `is_treeT_connected` / `is_treeT_connect` / `is_treeT_unique`, the introductions `is_treeTI` / `is_treeTI_connect`, and groundings: `'K_0`, `'K_1`, `'K_2` (B9's path-tree proofs) and the claw `'K_1,3` (a tree that B9's `path_tree` excludes; its irredundant paths are unique because a leaf's only neighbour is the centre) are trees; `'K_3` (`forest3`) and two isolated vertices (`compl 'K_2`) are not. Public-only client base/theories/examples/trees.v.

Seven complete current rows, frozen in extremal-graph-theory/theories/migration/whole_tree.v and packing-theory/theories/migration/whole_tree.v over the frozen wrapper and the LIVE aliases of the other families, every guard, quantifier order and natural subtraction exact: Extremal XE1 `erdos_548_statement` (k.+1 <= n, exact orders, the doubled edge bound `(k - 1) * n + 2`, the subgraph conclusion), `erdos_550_statement` (positive part sizes and the two smallest, N before n/RTB/RTG/T/G, the complete multipartite host and both least-Ramsey witnesses), `erdos_557_statement` (1 <= k, an additive C, the k-colour least-Ramsey relation), `erdos_568_statement` (both existential bounds, the uniform C, no isolated vertices, the exact edge count); Extremal XE2 `erdos_547_statement` (2 <= n, the least diagonal Ramsey number, R <= 2n - 2) and `erdos_549_statement` (no k > 0 guard, bipartition sizes k and 2k, R = 4k - 1; #547 and #549 are solved rows); Packing XE1 `erdos_743_statement` (2 <= n, the dependent family of trees of orders val k + 1, dependent injective embeddings with pairwise disjoint edge images covering every pair of 'K_n). Pre-existing prose issue recorded without repair: #548's doc says k >= 1 follows from its guards, but k = 0 is admitted by the statement; no statement, status or leg changes.

History: 22 earlier frozen declarations across A5 (subgraph_of), A6 (complement), A7 (edge_count), C7 (bipartition) and A11 (min_degree_at_least) still call the live wrapper; all are kept byte-exact, listed in known_stale_snapshots with reciprocal notes in those five specs. Five complete combined Originals are composed from the earlier families' Original templates with the new frozen tree substituted and certified end to end through their own Original certificates: `XE1Original.erdos_548_statement` (A7 edge count, A5 subgraph relation), `XE1Original.erdos_550_statement` (A6 Ramsey number), `XE1Original.erdos_568_statement` (A6 Ramsey number, A7 edge count, A11 no isolated vertices), `XE2Original.erdos_547_statement` (A6 diagonal Ramsey number), `XE2Original.erdos_549_statement` (C7 bipartition sizes, A6 diagonal Ramsey number). #557 and Packing #743 have no earlier snapshot.

Consumers: no proof body outside the three source files uses the wrappers or the row names; Extremal.XE2 imports Extremal.XE1 and Packing's vocabulary_packing facade imports Packing.XE1 (both recompile unchanged); the five earlier certificates are the historical consumers. No grounding or implication module is invented. Routing: normal milestones Extremal XE1, Extremal XE2 and Packing XE1; the family needs no Digraph build.

Distinct, untouched: B18's labelled `fg_spanning_tree`, B19's multigraph `spanning_tree_edge_set`, `D2tur.tree_on` / `shortest_tree_on`, `U9.tree_contains_T`, the directed trees of X2 and P9, B9's `path_tree`, and tree decompositions.
